## add read-base split columns to error.parquet

```
level: medium
date: 2026-10-13
```

### description

The user asked whether the `--error-out` Parquet can also carry
`to_a`/`to_c`/`to_g`/`to_t` and whether that is cheap. After a feasibility
answer, the user chose the 4-column option (no `to_n`). `to_x` counts
in-region substitutions at each 1-based position whose read (destination)
base is x.

### result

1. Implemented `to_a`/`to_c`/`to_g`/`to_t` columns in `error.parquet` (9-column schema).
2. Answered the cost question: negligible CPU, small memory, modest file growth.
3. Documented the N-base semantics in `docs/usage.qmd`.
